schema_note: No ratified schema exists in this repository. Keys are limited to what verification/locales/README.md and verify_locale_stream.py name explicitly, plus the optional untranslated_probe list, which the no_untranslated_fallback check consumes. Everything a run would produce is null: no artifact supports a value, so no value is written.

target.device_class: OPNsense firewall admin UI (outside this repository)
target.address_provenance: operator-attested 2026-09-28; the host named for the reported Italian pass
target.address_note: This value is an operator statement, not a verified fact. It closes nothing and must be corrected if an artifact shows a different host.

untranslated_probe_note: Empty on purpose. Until an English label list is supplied, no_untranslated_fallback is SKIP, never PASS.
checks_note: null means not exercised by or attributable to this workstream. It never means PASS.

markers.provenance: operator-attested, quoted verbatim in REPORT-it_IT-2026-09-28.md as the check strings [Riepilogo modifiche] and [Monitoraggio dispositivi]; the surrounding brackets belong to the operator's check-string notation, not to the label
markers.mapped_check_note: reported_status is an operator attestation. The harness reads marker text only and never copies a reported status into a result. Neither marker maps to a check name emitted by the verification/locales harness.

teardown.note: The harness has no teardown loop and no firewall integration. A firewall locale change is infrastructure state, not a documentation fact.

blocked_by: selenium is not importable on the recording host
no browser or WebDriver binary installed

exit_codes.1: at least one FAIL or ERROR

rules: Case data carries boundaries and provenance only. No field may hold a value that no artifact supports; unsupported values are null.
A reported result with no artifact stays PENDING-EVIDENCE. It never becomes PASS or RESOLVED.
Run output belongs in out/<locale>/ and must be the tool's own output, never a transcription.
Closing a locale item requires the acceptance checklist in verification/locales/out/README.md.
A locale change on a firewall is infrastructure state. Record the device build and its before/after locale state.
Operator attestation is recorded as attestation, with its provenance stated, and is never promoted to verified fact.
